reason: Under the transfer/leakage lens the idea cannot be validated and has a negative precedent. (1) Signal size vs. what we can measure: the research dose-response (24 videos) shows one extra xy quantisation costs only -0.0021 (44b6) / -0.0013 (6bba) edge recall before linefit, so perfect de-quantisation is worth about +0.001..+0.002 locally, less after linefit, and near 0 on top of the V1284 head. That is below the +0.002 gate and below public-LB resolution (one embryo, 3 decimals). The +0.048 swap/diverted oracle is unreachable: those offsets are ~4.4 um against 0.47 um grid noise. (2) In-sample lab: the detector saw all 199 train videos and all annotated nuclei. The closest precedent is Eric's (rank 77) sub-voxel peak refinement on the same public weights: +0.0078 on 12 local videos, -0.002 on the LB twice (discussions_summary l.354-358). A local pass here would carry the same in-sample bias, and its direction is unknown: the phase-0 argmax is memorised to floor(gt/4), while the phase-shifted inputs are unseen pixels of memorised nuclei. (3) The 'N_pred identical by construction' claim is false for the scored graph. The raw node set is fixed, but relink, gap closing, short-track filtering and linefit all use the coordinates. Our own coordhead port moved peaks by a mean of 0.74 um and final nodes fell from 122,704 to 119,174 (-2.9%; 44b6_0b24845f -10.7%). Through adj = J*(1-0.1*dN/N_est) that is worth about +0.0027 on its own, more than the whole expected polyphase edge gain. So a local win could easily be a node-multiplier artefact, and the forum says those reverse on the LB (min-track-length +0.013 offline, -0.004 public). The same applies to the '-10% error = +0.007' read of x138 used to scale the expected gain. (4) Arm C (+1.5 px floor de-bias without per-video recentring) is a constant offset. Measured GT-minus-pred offsets are embryo-specific (z +0.20 um on 44b6 vs +0.90 um on 6bba; y +0.24 vs +0.33 um), and a constant offset lost 0.0031 on the LB (Le Quang Canh). Any lab gain from C would be fitted to the train embryos' annotation convention. (5) The 44b6 videos are overlapping crops of one recording, so the 44b6 per-video win rate and CI treat roughly one recording as ~71 samples. With a ~0.001 effect, the embryo gate carries almost no evidence about private embryos. (6) Embryo shift dominates localisation: friend A's scratch 6bba model scored 0.833 on its own training videos vs 0.680 on unseen 44b6. On private embryos the non-quantisation error is larger, so the quantisation share (10-20% of variance locally) shrinks, and phase maps from a non-shift-equivariant U-Net on unseen embryos will disagree more (more guard fall-backs). The mechanism is physically real and label-free, but its payoff is below everything we can resolve, it rests on a lab of the exact kind that already failed for a sub-voxel refinement, and its 'no multiplier' safety claim does not hold.
fix_if_any: Only worth keeping as a low-priority fallback if the V1284 port stalls, and only in this form. (a) Drop arm C (no constant or floor de-bias); keep per-video median recentring mandatory; use the phase-consistency guard. (b) Do the Phase-1 localisation readout with a detector that never saw the evaluation embryo: friend A's LOEO scratch 6bba-only model, applied to 44b6 videos, with the 3 diagonal phases. KILL unless the median GT-to-matched-node distance falls by >= 5% there (not just on the in-sample public weights), and unless the guard fall-back rate on 44b6 is < 20% and within 1.5x of the rate on in-sample 6bba. (c) In the replay lab, decompose every delta into edge-J and multiplier terms. Require the gate on the edge-J term at matched final N_pred (or report dN/N_est and subtract 0.1*dN/N_est*J). Reject if |dN_final| > 0.5% on either embryo. (d) Count 44b6 as leak groups (cluster the overlapping crops by recording), not as 71 independent videos, for the CI and win rate. (e) Check test-time budget: +3 primary passes is +19% GPU on the hidden set; confirm the headroom under the Kaggle limit before spending a probe. Even when all of this passes, expect <= +0.001 on top of the head. That cannot be told apart on the public LB, so it should not take one of the remaining probes ahead of the head, head retraining, or detection-side ideas aimed at the 0.97 target.
realistic_public_gain: About +0.000 (range -0.002..+0.001) on top of the V1284 head; about +0.000..+0.002 without the head. Not resolvable on the public LB. The downside is bounded by Eric's precedent (-0.002 twice), plus -0.003 if arm C's constant offset ships.
